## Summary

This PR implements `sendEvent` in the following connectors and updates the existing test cases accordingly:

- connectAutocomplete
- connectGeoSearch
- connectHierarchicalMenu
- connectBreadcrumb
- connectMenu
- connectNumericMenu
- connectRange
- connectRatingMenu
- connectToggleRefinement 

**Stacked PRs**
1. [introduce `insights` middleware](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4446)
2. [send events from hits and refinementList](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4456)
3. [implement sendEvent in all the connectors](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4463) ← current
4. [add tests](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4464)

## Result

Now the connectors send event when refining, and expose `sendEvent` at `init` and `render` method.
